text: {"name":"ll_conn_event_rf_timing_init","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Initializes a BLE connection event's per-channel counter and derives its radio timing and configuration fields from the selected RF channel.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"v1":"event_flags","v4":"rf_config_index","v5":"channel_index","v7":"base_timing","v8":"previous_channel_counter","v9":"rf_config_entry","v11":"event_timing","v12":"timing_extension","v13":"rf_config_value"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":24,"meaning":"Byte-swapped timing value compared against a threshold."},{"offset":27,"meaning":"BLE channel index; 0xFF is a sentinel for no channel."},{"offset":28,"meaning":"Index used to select an RF configuration entry."},{"offset":29,"meaning":"Connection-context index."},{"offset":30,"meaning":"Event flags controlling whether fields are initialized and adjusting timing."},{"offset":32,"meaning":"Per-connection, per-channel 12-bit counter."},{"offset":50,"meaning":"Base radio timing value."},{"offset":51,"meaning":"Calculated event timing value."},{"offset":52,"meaning":"Optional timing extension."},{"offset":53,"meaning":"RF channel configuration value returned by rf_get_chan_cfg."},{"offset":66,"meaning":"Copy of the calculated event timing value."}]}
